normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, retain only alphanumeric code points; compare complete strings. Same-case input/target identity is expected for already-clean cases and is excluded from cross-row overlap.

fuzzy_screen.scope: all unordered case pairs, first nonexclusive target per case
fuzzy_screen.threshold: token SequenceMatcher ratio >= 0.55 OR set four-gram Dice >= 0.24

manual_shared_family_disclosures.shared_family: Deliberate adjective repetition elaborated by the audibility of a clock. One is a desired condition and the other an observation.
Repeated intensifier in a long-day complaint followed by a negative desire concerning recurrence.
Active correction from canceling one arrangement to keeping it while canceling another.
An event happens after another action has already taken place.
An unrealized transport intention contrasted with an alternative event.
Historical intention to sell a canoe with a later non-sale outcome.

limitations: Independently authored cases share ordinary correction, negation, chronology, quantity and narrative constructions. They are not independent template families.
The fuzzy screen is heuristic and does not enumerate every semantic or structural similarity.
